verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a developer API platform with an MCP server and SDK-style tooling, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics collection, or any opt-out control. The sandbox, webhooks, spend controls and MCP server items are unrelated to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
